scope: D1 host controller/message/input lifecycle + measurement only; no D2 presentation

workload.order: round-major in listed order, no extra measured/preparatory battles in these100
workload.seedRecipe: case ordinal i=0..99: [1,2,3,4+i]; both versions same resolvedseed recorded
requiredManifestFields: 100 unique case IDs in exact order
exact semantic choices and expected special events
each between-battle setup operation and its full write-set
workload.capabilities: actual formal B held-capable and C AI-enabled training paths; wild default AI unchanged

specialEvents.heldControls: specific fixed cases must exercise actual B held consumption/restoration; identity paired receipts and no forced data replacement

workload.setup: only explicit identical between-battle replenishment/healing at no-owner boundary; preserve current party/captures/receipts/stats across battles; never reset full document or clear caches each battle
workload.finalFreeze: exact input manifest/source/payload frozen and validated before formal runs; correction of fixture/version creates new manifest, retains failed pilot and cannot cherry-pick successful repetitions

versions.control: explicit bridge from accepted2ff containing only the same benchmark driver/hooks/manifest, original text-scene behavior; separate fixed SHA and patch manifest
versions.candidate: same bridge+minimal D1 controller, same driver/content/config/inputs/seed/setup
versions.oldMain: not baseline for new B/C workload; historical canonical budgets retained separately
versions.noMislabel: control is bridge not original2ff bytes; dependency/output/driver changes separately identified

runs.process: each is one fresh NW process for its full100, no per-battle restart/cache cleanup/GC
runs.naturalGc: no expose-gc flag and zero forced calls
runs.diagnosticGc: expose-gc; two explicit calls only at declared memory sample points; record success not inferred from flag; do not combine with natural medians
runs.missingOrFailure: record every attempted run and actual inputcount/outcomes/exit/timeout; no retry-to-green or sample selection
runs.instrumentOff: One additional adjacent control/candidate natural full100 pair with detailed timing instrumentation disabled; samedriver/manifest/choices, noGC. These 2 runs are separate from 3 instrumented-natural+1GC perversion and not included in instrumented frame medians. Boundary outcome/identity checks stay outside measured intervals; record exact disabled/enabled probes. If impossible, report instrumented-only and keep obligation OPEN, no silent waiver.

host.platform: macOS arm64 actual NW0.117/Chromium154 locked target; actual versions reported
host.focus: frontmost/visible; record actual loss and classify it, never suppress or relabel
host.concurrency: no local builds/tests/native processes in measurement window; no system-wide setting change or killing unrelated processes
host.profilesAndSaves: new per-process profiles and test saves; only own process tree cleanup; no user slots

timing.clock: raw monotonic performance.now, game updateMain tick/frame and rAF tick/frame distinct; wall clock only launch correlation
timing.separation: deliberate presentation wait/observed wait, readiness overhead without deliberate wait, total experience time separately; D1 has no D2 transition added
timing.gameVsRaf: 60Hz game vs120Hz screen never substitute; retain raw deltas and counts
timing.scope: document whether driver/assertions fall in timed intervals; no post-hoc subtracting slow frames or CPU attribution from elapsed waiting

fields: whole owned app tree RSS bytes
memory.ownedAppTree: sampler starts at launched exact PID, recursively enumerates only direct descendants and samples only verified owned PIDs; no whole-system ps/name substring sum
memory.unavailable: null+UNKNOWN and exact denied/unsupported reason; never0 or substitute renderer aswholeapp
memory.units: raw bytes and explicit MiB conversion; no rounded MB leak proof
memory.gcGroups: label actual gcForced per sample, separate natural/GC plots and growth4-to100

budgets.canonical: docs/step5/perf-budget.json unchanged including factor1.2 and memory100 warn7.2MB
budgets.newRows: bridge comparison distinct; missing truly comparable oldrow => NOT_COMPARABLE; no invented no-regression result
budgets.warnings: WARN remain WARN, not code failure or implicit exemption; new specific regressions investigated
budgets.P4: reproducible actual100/frame/identity report and review disposition; not a demand to clear all oldWARN
budgets.cpuAndAllocation: OPEN unless actual matching source/time attribution evidence exists

required: Showdown lock and actual stage/build hashes
identity.package: new fixed clean prebuilt package; no auto publish or global NW modification; all pre/post payload unchanged

acceptance.scenes: exact nonempty IDs/case order/count and expected outcomes; schema/missing/errors/timeouts fail closed
acceptance.legacyTests: oldT IDs map to controller semantic ready/choose/resolve/wait assertions, not only scene existence/private field names; original failures preserved
acceptance.lifecycle: old callback after abort/load/terminate cannot touch successor session/UI/op; busy/reentry/failure/finish transfer owners checked
acceptance.gates: quick/type/boundaries/SDK/B/C/friendship/golden + actualMac flow; each fixed batch ultra; fullD1P4 before D2
